label: rem-darboux-lhopital-taylor-scope
tail:
VERDICT: DEFECTS

FINDING 1
  location: Remarks, paragraph beginning "Darboux's property alone has no general continuity converse; the page proves continuity only under the stated injectivity or monotonicity hypotheses."
  severity: fatal
  claim:    The page `darboux-lhopital-and-taylor` contains a proof that a derivative is continuous under injectivity or monotonicity hypotheses.
  evidence: The items provided from that page (the remark itself, `def-higher-derivatives-and-smoothness`, and the six named theorems) contain no statement of injectivity or monotonicity hypotheses and no proof of continuity of a derivative under such conditions. The claimed proof is absent from the page; therefore the remark asserts a falsehood about the page’s content.

BOUNDARY: Checked edge cases in the cited items (Peano n=0, factorial 0! convention, one‑sided endpoint conventions) and found no misrepresentation; the only defect is the unsupported meta‑claim above.
SOURCES:  All ten supplied cited items were inspected and compared with the remark’s descriptions.
CHECKED:  Title, the complete Remarks (the public statement), and every sentence of the Remarks verified against the provided items.
